candidates.title: Boss Phase-Two Readable Counterplay
candidates.why: Live code already has strong boss preview guidance and a universal 50% health phase-two transition, but the transition only said PHASE 2 while secretly increasing speed and projectile pressure. The highest-pressure boss moment should give the player one concrete counter, not just a spectacle cue.
candidates.recipe: Add a pure boss phase-two warning helper in `src/systems/bossPhases.js`, cover every guided boss type plus unknown fallback, and have `triggerBossPhaseTwoTransition()` emit the warning directly under the phase banner.

L1.recipe: Add a generic phase-two warning line to the existing transition.

L2.recipe: Add tested per-boss phase-two warnings and wire them into the transition.

L3.recipe: Also feed the warning into aria-live and post-run boss coaching when phase two caused the death.

skipped.reason: Deferred because current replay resim is intentionally labeled heuristic/advisory; replacing it with a true runner is larger than a safe continuation slice and needs a dedicated design pass.
Deferred because extracting the full boss update loop from App.jsx has higher regression risk than this audited readability patch.

executionLog.notes: Added getBossPhaseTwoWarning(), wired it into triggerBossPhaseTwoTransition(), and covered known-boss plus fallback warning behavior. Focused verification: npx vitest run src/systems/bossPhases.test.js -> 4/4 passing.
